WITH rental_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
avg_rental_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) AS avg_total
  FROM rental_payments
)
SELECT 
  rp.store_id,
  SUM(rp.rental_total) AS combined_payment_total,
  AVG(rp.rental_total) - (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_rental_total) AS avg_beat
FROM rental_payments rp
WHERE rp.rental_total > (SELECT avg_total FROM avg_rental_total)
GROUP BY rp.store_id
